caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, metal iron gate painted in shades of brown and gray, with a focus on its three-dimensional structure and decorative elements. The gate features vertical and horizontal bars forming a grid, with symmetrical scrollwork embellishing each section—these scrolls appear at regular intervals along the bars. At the top, there is a finial with elegant, curling shapes, providing a decorative flourish. The body of the gate is bent outward in a slight curve. Below the main gate, there are two separate metal hinge-like components displayed side by side. The background is plain and beige, making the gate and its details stand out clearly. In the lower right corner, there is handwritten text displaying the names "Geoffrey Holt" and "HARRY M. WADDELL."
title: Window Grille
